summary: Two commits applied on the Library head. Report a bug (the corner button and its dialog on the new surfaces; fields read-only and Send aria-disabled while a report is out), one pass by a new reviewer: lows-only, no high or medium. Admin follow-ups (the eight lows from Admin's second pass), one pass by Admin's reviewer: lows-only, all eight in. Both were read on the builder's branch before Library landed; here App.tsx carries the same hunk and the contrast audit drops all three exemptions the two sides removed. Open lows: bug report tests cannot see an unusable launcher and do not pin a same-tick double press; the launcher covers the end of a page on a phone; three strings still say submit; the error is not tied to its field; read-only fields look editable; removing the attachment drops focus; the 320px action row is tight; after a refused send the action row can be partly out of view. Admin: the second read after a close mid-match can move focus and scroll; the two reads can land out of order; the slowest of N is a 95th percentile.
